description: Crossing gates across the Rosario Strait shipping lane. Each gate is a line from end_a to end_b; a vessel 'arrives' when its track crosses the line.

collection_box.comment: AIS subscription box: Rosario Strait plus approaches (Cherry Point, Guemes Channel, south entrance).

vessel_filter.comment: Cargo (70-79) and tankers (80-89) of at least min_length_m, plus any vessel reporting towing (type 31/32 or nav status 11/12) regardless of length. Tugs not towing, ferries and small craft are excluded.
